title: Two Coordinated Drone Strikes on Wedding-Bound Vehicles Kill 23
detail: Two drone strikes hit vehicles carrying wedding guests on July 6, 2026: in Al-Sha'tout, North Kordofan, a strike killed 13 people (including 5 women); on the outskirts of Omdurman, a separate strike killed 10 people, all members of one family. The Sudan Doctors Network called the attacks deliberate and blamed RSF-guided drones for both strikes, which together killed at least 23 civilians in a single day and drew condemnation as a deliberate targeting of civilians rather than incidental collateral damage.

title: El Obeid Siege Intensifies; 5,500+ Children Among Displaced in Two Weeks
detail: The RSF controlled all routes into El Obeid except the eastern approach by early July 2026, with a sustained drone campaign hitting hospitals, markets, schools, fuel depots, water infrastructure, and power stations — 16+ civilian and service targets damaged by OSINT count. The city had been without electricity for roughly a month by mid-July. Save the Children reported more than 11,000 people fled the area in the two weeks to July 6, including 5,500+ children, while up to 500,000 civilians were described as at risk. Al Jazeera and UN News drew explicit comparisons to El Fasher's October 2025 fall, in which 6,000+ people were killed in three days.
